crops.reading: Same face as the 507: black band with two screens and gangway window, orange line, dome with a round LED lamp, two marker lenses, M roundel left, number right, black teardrop pods, yellow valance with dark slots.
Screens in black riveted frames with rounded corners; gangway door window taller between; amber display top right, blank box top left; wiper on the right screen only, hanging from the top.
crops.reader2: Same three-part band, one wiper on the right screen pivoting at its top left, orange line turning a short way down the band edges. Agrees.

crops.reading: Round LED roof lamp on a yellow plinth; two white marker lenses below the orange line.
crops.reader2: Same as the 507: LED roof lamp, orange line, two grey marker discs just under it. Agrees.

crops.reading: Black teardrop pod: big headlamp outboard and higher, small LED tail lamp inboard and lower.
crops.reader2: Big clear lamp upper left (outboard, higher), small LED lower right. Agrees.

crops.reading: Mirror: headlamp outboard and higher, LED tail inboard and lower.
Gangway door, black upper half with window, yellow lower half with handle, dark strips either side.
Dark slots under the pods, yellow valance; coupler below.
M roundel: grey disc, yellow-orange M.
508141 in black on the yellow.

Grey unit 508120: yellow face ends at the corner; on the cab side a yellow wave with black dotted edges (this unit's Good Communications artwork); orange cantrail line; the red tail lamp lit inboard of the headlamp.
crops.reader2: One wiper at the top of the right screen; headlamp outboard and higher, red lamp inboard lower; orange line on the face and an orange cantrail line on the silver side at about the same height, looking continuous; black band with yellow dots low on the side. Agrees.

crops.reading: 508108 cab corner: yellow ends at the corner; grey bodyside; fixed cab window then the cab door; thin yellow line low along the side, yellow line-art.
crops.reader2: Cab door first behind the corner, then windows; orange cantrail line starting just behind the corner, about at the band top; thin low yellow line; no side roundel. Agrees except the fixed cab window (not called out).
crops.settled: The fixed window is the narrow opening at 680-696 px, ahead of the door seal; too small in this 1600 px photo for a reader to separate.

crops.reading: Grey car: yellow door leaves with orange-red surrounds, black-framed windows, orange cantrail line, yellow line-art and a thin low yellow line. No bodyside logo.
crops.reader2: Yellow leaves, red/orange edges, orange cantrail line, thin low yellow line, line-art and some lettering, no roundel. Agrees.

crops.reading: Second door: yellow leaves, tall windows, orange seal.

crops.reading: Behind the cab door on 508120 the yellow wave with dotted black stripes sweeps down the cab side: artwork specific to this unit.

crops.reading: Yellow-background unit: cab door with a droplight, then a small fixed window with rounded corners nearer the front; orange cantrail line.
crops.reader2: A recessed door-shaped panel with a rounded top holding two windows, a shorter one nearer the front and a taller one behind, a handrail between; could not tell whether the front one is a separate fixed window. Partly agrees.
crops.settled: Settled with s-cabwin-138w: the front window has its own rounded frame, outside the door's front seal (the black line running down at 897-905 px); a fixed window, as on the 507.
